identity.publisher: The British Editorial Society of Bone & Joint Surgery (Bone & Joint)
identity.source_note: Encoded from the live BJR Instructions for Authors page via clean WebFetch (not bot-blocked, not an archive). Gold open access journal; publisher unchanged (Bone & Joint / BESBJS). Submission via ScholarOne Manuscripts (mc04.manuscriptcentral.com/bjr).

encoding_notes: Clean live WebFetch of boneandjoint.org.uk/journal/BJR/instructions-for-authors (Tier A); not bot-blocked, no archive used.

Article types: guide names 'Original Research Articles' -> original_research and 'Editorials and Infographics' -> editorial; Infographics has no clean schema slot (omitted; ~300 words each). Systematic reviews / meta-analyses accepted (PRISMA and MOOSE reporting guidelines cited as applicable) -> systematic_review added, treated as a form of original research. BJR explicitly does NOT publish case reports, case series of non-consecutive patients, clinical papers, genetics/GWAS/Mendelian-randomization papers, or theses -> no case_report/case_series slots.

Blinding: guide states 'All articles published in BJR will have undergone rigorous, double-blinded peer review' -> double_blind true. Title Page and Main Document must be uploaded separately and 'should not be merged into one file' -> separate_title_page true. The guide does not spell out 'remove author names from the main document', but scrub_body_identifiers and scrub_metadata are set true as the required consequence of confirmed double-blind review + the title-page/main-document split that carries all author, affiliation, acknowledgement and contribution info on the title page.
line_spacing: guide says '1.5- or double-line spacing throughout' (either permitted); encoded as 'double' since it satisfies the rule; 1.5 is also acceptable per the guide.
line_numbers set 'none' (schema enum has no null) because line numbering is not mentioned in the guide; not a stated requirement.
font family/size, page size, margins, alignment, first-line indent, page numbers, running head all unstated in the guide -> null / false.
Abstract: structured 'Aims / Methods / Results / Conclusion', 'No more than 300 words'. Keywords 'No more than five ... given beneath the Abstract' -> max 5, required true.

Original Research body order: 'Abstract ... Introduction ... Methods ... Results ... Discussion ... References' (sections field encodes the IMRAD body). A required 'Article Summary' (subsections: Article focus / Key messages / Strengths and limitations of this study) is also mandatory -> mapped to misc.highlights_required true (closest schema slot; it is NOT an Elsevier-style bullet 'highlights' block).

Word limits: Original Research 'Reports should not exceed 4000 words including references' (note: cap INCLUDES references). Editorials '1200 to 1500 words ... excluding references' -> editorial manuscript_max_words 1500. Infographics ~300 words (no slot). Systematic-review word cap not separately stated -> null; the 4000-word / 10-figure / 8-table general caps likely apply but are not type-specific in the guide.

Figure/table caps are journal-wide: '10 figures or fewer in the main document' (with 'no more than 6 parts each') and 'maximum of 8 tables'; encoded under original_research. 'Text included in tables will not count towards overall word count' (no schema field).

References: 'Vancouver system by superscript numbers in the order of their appearance. Not in alphabetical order.' Example 'Allen GM, Wilson DJ. Ultrasound and the diagnosis of orthopaedic disorders. Bone Joint J 2013;95-B:944-51.' -> superscript, cited order, NLM-abbreviated journal names, no DOI shown. et_al_threshold not stated (example has 2 authors). No hard max_count ('usually below 50', soft guidance) -> max_count null.

tables.placement not explicitly stated (single Word document upload; figures uploaded separately). Encoded 'grouped_end' as the conservative in-document convention; guide silent on exact table location. tables.caption_position 'above' from 'Each table should have a short, descriptive heading'. tables.numbering left null (Table numbering scheme not stated).

figures.legends_location not explicitly stated ('Each figure will need a full descriptive legend'); encoded 'figure_legends_section' (legends compiled in the main document) as the conventional read; guide does not pin the location. figures.formats 'jpeg or tiff'; min_dpi / callout style / naming pattern unstated -> null. Figures uploaded as individual files, not embedded in the Word doc.

Declarations: title page must carry Funding, Conflicts of Interest (ICMJE form required), Acknowledgements + affiliations, and Author's contributions; a data-availability statement is required in published manuscripts; ethics-committee approval and informed consent required for studies on patients/volunteers (conditional -> not in 'required').
ORCID 'We ask that authors add an ORCID ID ... if available' -> encouraged, not required. Cover letter / highlights (classic) / title case not specified -> null/false.
